transcript: As Milo notes in the show, so I'm really glad Playwrights and Milo are telling this one. This is so true, comprised of a series of songs, another program for my collection. School Pictures is a solo show written and performed by Milo Cramer interspersed with nuggets of wisdom about education and art. each one about a student Milo has tutored in New York City. “those with urgent stories don't have the means to tell them, It was funny and quirky and such a poignant portrait of youth in this moment, and those with the means to tell stories don't have urgent stories to tell.” I really loved this show. Tonight I saw School Pictures at Playwrights Horizons. I would highly recommend this show. With that,
